appLead: Browser-only matching. Files stay in this tab — nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored.
privacyNote: All matching runs locally in this tab. Files never leave your device.
docsLead: Short guide for browser-only bank statement matching.
docsStep1: Upload a bank statement (PDF / CSV / TXT).
docsStep2: Upload the income report and the expense report.
docsStep3: Press Match. Comparison runs only in this tab.
docsStep4: Review unmatched rows and download the CSV if needed. Press Clear to reset.
docsMatchBody: Rows match on amount (±0.05), date (±1 day), and purpose text overlap. Near misses and rows present on only one side stay in the unmatched lists.
docsSamplesBody: Ready-made fixtures live in the repository. Download them, then upload in the app.
docsPromptBody: Clone this starter, put your statement and reports under public/examples/, then paste the prompt below into Cursor (or any coding agent). It should only touch parse/pdf — not add a backend.
docsPromptTip2: Ask the agent to dump a few PDF text lines first, then fix amount vs balance.
docsPromptTip3: Require npm test && npm run build before you trust the result.
docsPrompt:
Read AGENTS.md. Adapt this starter to my bank statement.

Statement: public/examples/<my-bank>.pdf
Income:    public/examples/income.csv
Expense:   public/examples/expense.csv

Make parse/pdf extract correct date, operation amount (not running balance), and purpose (including wrapped lines). Keep match.ts fuzzy rules. Stay browser-only.
Add vitest cases for a few lines from this PDF. Run npm test && npm run build.
